_readme: Shared by node scripts/check-contact.mjs (isUsablePhone/localDigits in src/utils/contact.ts) and server/tests/smoke.sh (pn_phone_local in server/src/storage.php). [text, domestic form or "" when unusable]. Rule: strip non-digits, 0084/84 prefix becomes 0, then a leading 0 and 9-11 digits are required (a bare 9-digit number without the 0 is NOT accepted). Edit both implementations together.
